summary: All 10 online boxes independently re-verified in ONE UT99 match on the dev host server: roster named Fleet110/123/124/133/143/171/184/186/240/243 (10/16, 0 bots), every box sending sustained packets to :7797 in a 12 s tcpdump, nine in-game frames with HUD ranks out of 10 (.243 is Voodoo 2 / GDI-blind, witnessed by roster+server.log+packets). Game then closed on all boxes; PROCLIST shows no Unreal process anywhere and the server roster is 0/16.
issues: .124: UnrealTournament.exe did not close on WM_CLOSE within 12 s and was force-killed by lanparty (box answered afterwards, desktop 1280x1024@85, agent console in foreground).
.243: UT killed (console quit/PROCKILL path); agent still answers, foreground Shell_TrayWnd; Voodoo 2 pass-through state cannot be seen via GDI - not verifiable remotely.
.184: final check frame showed no HUD/weapon (likely death-cam) though roster and packets confirm it in the match.
.186 desktop reports refresh=1 (driver default on the Standard VGA stub) - pre-existing, not caused by this round.
